title: Yoto Player (Cloud API)
description: Bridges Yoto Players to Matter via the Yoto cloud API. Authenticates with OAuth2 device flow; check plugin logs for the user_code and visit https://api.yotoplay.com/device/auth to authorize.

clientId.title: OAuth Client ID
clientId.description: OAuth2 client id used with the Yoto API.

accessToken.title: Access Token
accessToken.description: Yoto OAuth access token (managed automatically after first authorization).

refreshToken.title: Refresh Token
refreshToken.description: Yoto OAuth refresh token (managed automatically after first authorization).

tokenExpiresAt.title: Token Expiry (epoch ms)
tokenExpiresAt.description: When the current access token expires (managed automatically).

pollingIntervalSeconds.title: Polling Interval (s)
pollingIntervalSeconds.description: How often to poll device status when MQTT is unavailable.

useMqtt.title: Use MQTT
useMqtt.description: Enable MQTT for real-time state updates (recommended). Falls back to polling if disabled or unavailable.

whiteList.title: White List
whiteList.description: Only the players in the list (by name) will be exposed.

blackList.title: Black List
blackList.description: Players in the list (by name) will not be exposed.

unregisterOnShutdown.title: Unregister On Shutdown
unregisterOnShutdown.description: Unregister all devices on shutdown (debug only).
